    Fit an establishment dose-response model

    Source: R/inv-introduction.R
    inv_establishment_prob.Rd

    Estimates the probability that an introduction establishes as a function of propagule size by maximum likelihood. Three models are available:

    Usage

    inv_establishment_prob(
  .data,
  established,
  propagules,
  model = c("exponential", "weibull", "logistic"),
  conf_level = 0.95
)

    Arguments

    .data

    A data frame with one row per introduction event.

    established

    <tidy-select> Column with the outcome: logical, 0/1 or a two-level factor (first level is success).

    propagules

    <tidy-select> Column with propagule size (positive numbers).

    model

    One of "exponential", "weibull" or "logistic".

    conf_level

    Confidence level for intervals.

    Value

    An object of class inv_establishment, a list with the fitted parameters, their variance-covariance matrix, the log-likelihood, AIC, n50 (the propagule size giving 50% establishment) and the data used. Use tidy(), glance(), augment(), predict() and autoplot() on it.

    Details

    • "exponential": P(N) = 1 - exp(-alpha * N), where each propagule establishes independently with probability alpha (no Allee effect).

    • "weibull": P(N) = 1 - exp(-alpha * N^c) (Leung et al. 2004). c > 1 indicates an Allee effect, c < 1 diminishing returns.

    • "logistic": logit P(N) = b0 + b1 * log(N).

    The binomial likelihood is maximised with stats::optim() on an unconstrained scale; standard errors come from the numerical Hessian.

    References

    Leung, B., Drake, J. M. and Lodge, D. M. (2004). Predicting invasions: propagule pressure and the gravity of Allee effects. Ecology, 85, 1651-1660. doi:10.1890/02-0571

    Examples

    fit <- inv_establishment_prob(inv_introductions, established, propagule_size,
  model = "weibull")
fit
#> <inv_establishment> weibull dose-response model
#> 240 introduction events, log-likelihood -79.706
#> Estimates: alpha = 0.009128, c = 1.538
#> Propagules for 50% establishment: 16.71
tidy(fit)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>   term  estimate std.error conf.low conf.high
#>   <chr>    <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1 alpha  0.00913   0.00504  0.00310    0.0269
#> 2 c      1.54      0.191    1.21       1.96  
glance(fit)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 7
#>   model       n logLik   AIC   BIC   n50 converged
#>   <chr>   <int>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <lgl>    
#> 1 weibull   240  -79.7  163.  170.  16.7 TRUE     
predict(fit, data.frame(propagule_size = c(1, 10, 100)))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   propagules   .pred
#>        <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1          1 0.00909
#> 2         10 0.270  
#> 3        100 1.000
